organizationRules.description: Files should be placed in directories that align with their UcF department designation
Files should follow the naming convention: [CompanyPrefix]-[DeptNumber].[FunctionNumber]-[TaskIdentifier].[extension]
Files should be grouped by function within department directories
Only physical documents should include dates in their filenames. Digital files should rely on metadata and version control systems.
WordPress files, critical tools, legal documents maintain original filenames but should be in appropriate directories

fileManagementPractices.description: Create backups before batch renaming files
Run file organization checks daily to maintain compliance
Document all organizational changes in memory.md and changelog.md
Use the provided tools for file management rather than manual reorganization
